name: Adventure Compass
longDescription: Used to navigate through adventures. Increases success rate in exploration.

name: Alcohol
longDescription: Makes you tipsy. May affect robbing or gambling outcomes.

name: Ammo
longDescription: Required for using weapons. Boosts attack success.

name: Apple
longDescription: Heals you a little bit. Not much, but it’s something.

name: Bank Note
longDescription: Can be deposited instantly. Useful for quick banking.

name: Bottle of Whiskey
longDescription: Strong drink. May boost courage or cause chaos.

longDescription: Brazilian cocktail. May improve luck or robbing.

name: Candy
longDescription: Sweet treat. Slightly boosts mood and luck.

longDescription: Seasonal snack. May trigger Halloween events.

longDescription: Tasty snack. May boost energy or cause a mess.

longDescription: Weird relic. May trigger romantic events or charm NPCs.

name: Elf On The Shelf
longDescription: Holiday watcher. May summon gifts or punish naughty behavior.

name: Energy Drink
longDescription: Gives you a temporary boost in energy, increasing your chances of success in some actions.

name: Fishing Bait
longDescription: Improves fishing success. Required for catching rare fish.

longDescription: Boosts luck for a short time. Useful for gambling or loot.

longDescription: Delicious food. Restores energy and boosts mood.

longDescription: Used to unlock prestige features. May boost all stats temporarily.

longDescription: Improves robbing success. Reduces chance of getting caught.

longDescription: Can be thrown at enemies. May distract or annoy them.

name: Spooky Mask
longDescription: Scares others. May trigger fear-based effects or events.

name: Stolen Amulet
longDescription: Cursed item. May grant power or backfire horribly.

longDescription: Prevents your streak from resetting. Use before missing a day.

longDescription: Collects tips from other players. Can be placed in chat to earn coins passively.

name: Vaccine
longDescription: Protects you from certain negative effects or diseases in-game.

name: Voodoo Doll
longDescription: Targets another player with a random curse. Effects vary from coin loss to stat debuffs.
